title: Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow - Chaotic Realm (Abandoned Room)
description:
SmithyGCN made the spritesheet and I converted this background into SMW.

It's seen in the empty rooms of the Chaotic Realm and it has mode 7-like effect in the original game.

You can use it with mode 7 if you're an ASM hacker or use it as a BG.

SmithyCGN deserves credit.
